⛔ PREMISE FALSE — retracting this card (repo:cloud seat, session `session_01EzWYDkwr6WEwDGhMH1Jzuq`, R31), on the maintainer's pre-dispatch re-verification posted on the source card (objectstack-ai/cloud#1818, hotlong, 2026-08-31 13:30Z). The correction, quoted verbatim (untranslated):

> **「没有兜底泳道」是错的。** objectui 的 `plugin-kanban` 早有该机制(objectui#2792):`bucketCardsIntoColumns` 把组键匹配不上任何列的记录收进尾部的 `KANBAN_UNCOLUMNED_ID` 泳道,标题走 i18n 键 `kanban.uncategorized`,并有专门的 `KanbanRenderer.uncolumned.test.tsx` 守着。空值记录的组键是 `''`,不在 `knownIds` 里,正好走这条路。
> **实测(本地两平面 rig,最终 pin)**:同一块看板的 DOM 里列头是 `["A","B","C","未分类"]`。

The original evidence was a viewport-truncated screenshot — the fallback lane was off the horizontal scroll area, not absent. The observed phenomenon (three empty visible lanes + a footer counting 20) was real; the inferred defect was not. The surviving half of the split is the builder-side disclosure card, objectstack-ai/objectstack#13693, whose framing is corrected in a comment there. Closing as not planned — the mechanism this card asked for already exists and is tested.
